origin: OpenCode 1.18.16 request (a Claude model in the capture; the model is changed to gemini-2.5-pro): the request that asks for a summary of a session that used tools, sent without the tools: a Gemini model behind a relay may refuse a history of calls and answers when no function is declared, so the history is written out as text. The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
